picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: A return to inflation above 4.5% would upend Federal Reserve rate plans, bond yields, and real wage gains for households.

picks.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 4.1% in October?
picks.why: Unemployment rising above 4.1% would signal labor market cooling and shape how the Fed balances jobs against inflation.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: About a fifth of global oil passes through Hormuz, so prolonged disruption affects energy prices, inflation, and growth worldwide.

picks.question: Will Google have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Which firm leads frontier AI influences where investment, talent, and productivity gains from the technology are likely to concentrate.

picks.question: Will AI solve 0 more Millennium Prize Problems in 2026?
picks.why: Whether AI can crack famous open math problems is a useful gauge of how far machine reasoning has actually advanced.
